metadata.executor: real `claude -p --strict-mcp-config --output-format stream-json` subprocess, one per trial, via evals/lib/run-mcp-trials.sh
metadata.notes: Baseline for sift-email using Gmail's Important mark and star, a time-based search for new mail, and a daily review of how the user handles mail (PR #129, issue #128), evals 1-25, two runs each, with run-mcp-trials.sh against the Gmail, Claude Docs, and Contacts stubs. Both runs were on SKILL.md as of commit 4d9f1c0, run in parallel with separate trial directories under $TMPDIR. Every eval prompt starts with /sift-email. Both runs were on 2026-10-24 in the rubric timezone (2026-10-25 in UTC for eval 1, whose starter rubric is UTC); fixtures are anchored to 2026-10-10 and shifted two weeks by fixture-dates.py, and graders held the run date to the date the run's clock gave. Failures: eval 11 in both runs (read the whole rubric before the Step 2 checks; the previous two baselines missed this in one run each). Not graded: eval 18 run 1 wrote its run heading in bold rather than as a ### heading, which the next run reads its search start from; run entries sometimes land above the Runs intro (evals 1 and 24); eval 3 run 1 wrote an (inferred) note in first person; the Bulk and Junk split for marketing and list mail varies between runs (eval 19's potluck invitation); the Daily review note usually sits in the run summary rather than on its own line; and unrequested (inferred) About me notes and category labels.
